item.title: Orthodox world bids farewell to Patriarch Ilia II of Georgia (+VIDEO)
item.description: On Sunday, March 22, the funeral of Catholicos-Patriarch Ilia II of Georgia was held at the Holy Trinity Cathedral in Tbilisi, with primates and representatives of Local Orthodox Churches, state and political leadership, clergy, and thousands of the Georgian faithful in attendance.

item.title: Monday of the Fifth Week of Great Lent
item.description: He who has acquired love has banished enmity; but he who harbors enmity stores up for himself needless labors.

item.title: Poverty of spirit is the foundation of spiritual life—Metropolitan Onuphry
item.description: “Without humility before God, even fasting and prayer will bear no fruit,” His Beatitude Metropolitan Onuphry of Kiev and All Ukraine, the primate of the Ukrainian Orthodox Church, said in his homily on the Fourth Sunday of Great Lent, the Sunday of St. John Climacus.

item.title: The Lay Order of Vespers. In the Rhythm of the Church, Part 5
item.description: For someone reading the lay order of the services, the stichera are a tricky but fascinating moment when you have to juggle several books at once.

item.title: Tuesday of the Fifth Week of Great Lent
item.description: Love of money is idolatry. Idle talk and jesting give birth to falsehood.

item.title: Uncovering of the relics of St. Chrysostomos the Missionary in DR Congo
item.description: The rite was led by Patriarch Theodoros of Alexandria, together with hierarchs and clergy from other dioceses of the Patriarchate of Alexandria.

item.title: Bulgarian Patriarch and delegation make pilgrimage to St. Gabriel (Urgebadze)’s relics and cell
item.description: St. Gabriel’s relics are located at the Samtavro Monastery of the Transfiguration in Mtskheta, the ancient capital of Georgia.

item.title: “There’s no authentic Christianity without asceticism,”—Romanian Archbishop of Great Britain
item.description: Turning to the broader meaning of fasting, the Archbishop called Great Lent a universal invitation to holiness.

item.title: Greek clergy group criticizes Council of State ruling on same-sex marriage and adoption
item.description: The Holy Association of Greek Clergy (ISKE) has issued a statement criticizing the recent Council of State decision reaffirming the constitutionality of same-sex marriage and adoption in Greece.

item.title: 1,400th anniversary of Akathist hymn, “an intricately woven work of Divinely inspired theology”—Constantinople
item.description: Patriarch Bartholomew and the Holy Synod of Constantinople issued an encyclical marking the 1,400th anniversary of the first solemn standing chanting of the Akathist Hymn, commemorating the deliverance of Constantinople from the siege of the Avars and Persians in 626 AD.
